3. **Green Goddess**: 1 scoop protein powder, 1 ripe banana, 1 cup frozen spinach, 1/2 cup unsweetened coconut water, 1/2 cup ice, 1 teaspoon chia seeds.  
4. **Mocha Madness**: 1 scoop protein powder, 1 ripe banana, 1/4 cup strong brewed coffee, 1/2 cup unsweetened almond milk, 1 tablespoon unsweetened cocoa powder, ice cubes.  
5. **Tropical Temptation**: 1 scoop protein powder, 1 ripe banana, 1/2 cup frozen mango, 1/2 cup unsweetened coconut milk, 1/4 teaspoon turmeric powder, ice cubes.
